info.title: Trickle API
info.description:
Metadata API for Trickle: sessions, users, companies, workers, invites, gas sponsorship and FX. Money lives on-chain; this API never stores balances.

Sign in by exchanging a Privy access token at `POST /api/v1/sessions`, then send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Resource endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Errors always use `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`: 400 for unreadable requests, 422 for schema validation failures (one `details` entry per field). List endpoints take `?limit=&cursor=` and return `{ data, nextCursor }`.

post.summary: Sign in with a Privy access token
post.description: Exchanges the access token from Privy (`getAccessToken()` in the web app) for a Trickle session token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected endpoints. The account is keyed to the Privy embedded wallet; 409 `WALLET_NOT_READY` means Privy has not created that wallet yet, so retry shortly.

token.description: Opaque session token. Only its hash is stored server-side

delete.summary: Sign out (revoke the session token used for this request)

get.summary: Current user and the roles they hold

post.summary: Create a company (makes the caller an employer)
post.description: One active company per account. The new id is also returned as `companyId` by `GET /api/v1/users/me`.

delete.summary: Delete a company I own (soft delete)
delete.description: Refused with 409 `COMPANY_HAS_WORKERS` while workers are still linked. Pending invites are revoked. The row is kept for history, but the company disappears from the API and the caller can create a new one.

post.summary: Add a worker to my company by wallet address
post.description: Alternative to a worker invite when the employer already knows the address. Re-adding a removed worker restores them. 409 `WORKER_EXISTS` if they already work here.

monthlySalaryUsd.description: Reference monthly salary in USD, shown in the UI. Pay itself is the on-chain stream

address.description: The worker's Trickle (Privy embedded) wallet address
